description: This Python script is used to send a control-plane YAML message to a WebSocket server for virtual HDMI-CEC logical address configuration in a test environment. It reads a YAML file, connects to a WebSocket URI, and transmits the YAML data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _read_yaml(file_path: str)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML file into a Python dictionary, ensuring the root is a dict.

methods.name: None _send_yaml(uri: str, yaml_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously sends YAML data over a WebSocket connection and optionally prints a response.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, reads the YAML file, and initiates the WebSocket transmission.

ctags.name: _send_yaml
ctags.pattern: /^async def _send_yaml(uri: str, yaml_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/
